title: Tech Note: Inside the XMLTreeList System
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the XmlTreeList routines that mirror a DOM XML tree onto a 4D hierarchical list interface object for display, using internal ID-matching arrays to keep the list and the underlying DOM tree in sync without duplicating all the XML data. The general technique of pairing a lightweight display structure with a reference-based lookup back to the source data is still a valid UI pattern, but 4D's classic hierarchical list widget and the 2004-era XML Tools component itself are legacy technology, long since surpassed by modern list/tree UI components and JSON-based data structures in current 4D and web development. It predates 4D v11's SQL engine, Project Mode, and ORDA.
related_updates: 4D has continued to enhance native list-box and tree-display UI objects well beyond the classic hierarchical list used here
JSON has largely replaced XML for data interchange in modern 4D applications, reducing reliance on this kind of XML-to-UI mapping code
The standalone XML Tools component is not part of any current, actively distributed 4D toolkit
